entities.summary: The École nationale d'Ingénieurs de Tarbes is a French school of engineering leading to the French Diplôme d'Ingénieur under the authority of the French Ministry of Education and Research and part of the National Polytechnic Institute of Toulouse (INPT). Founded in 1963, about 200 students graduate from the ENIT each year. ENIT is part of the ENI group, which is a network of 4 French public engineering schools.
